title: Isexwayiso Esincane Ngaphambi Komuntu Ohamba Ngomkhumbi
intro: Ngena esigodini lapho umbusi onamandla kanye nebutho elikhulu lisondela khona, bese ucabanga ngomhambi omncane enikeza isixwayiso esisindisa umphakathi wonke. Njengoba umphakathi osongelwayo ufika endaweni yokukhosela, ingozi iyadlula. Landela izinkomba ukuze uthole umuntu onganakwa ngemuva kwaleso sixwayiso.
clues: Ngiphakathi kwezidalwa ezincane ezihlotshaniswa nombuso wombusi.
Umphakathi wami uhlala ezindlini ngaphakathi kwesigodi, lapho omunye wethu angabiza khona abanye.
Sibhekene nosongo oluvela kulowo mbusi kanye namabutho ahamba nombusi.
Ngingulowo obiza umphakathi wami ukuthi ungene emakhaya awo futhi osixwayisa ukuthi singacindezelwa ngokungazi.
Umbusi nguSulayman, futhi uhlobo lwami luphakathi kwezidalwa ezibekwe ngaphansi komyalo wakhe.
Ngiyintuthwane yaleso sigodi; ngemva kwesixwayiso sami, sangena emakhaya ethu futhi sasinda ekucindezelweni okwakungasifica singazi.

outcome.answer: Umphakathi usindiswe ngemuva kokuthola indawo yokukhosela

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
